dataset: IDRiD B. Disease Grading (Official Testing Set)
decision_rationale: Predefined promotion rule evaluated on held-out IDRiD dataset (N=41): Candidate ECE=0.1412 vs Baseline ECE=0.1789 (Pass: True); Candidate Brier=0.1193 vs Baseline Brier=0.1319 (Pass: True); Candidate Sensitivity=96.30% vs Baseline Sensitivity=96.30% (Pass: True); Candidate Specificity=64.29% vs Baseline Specificity=57.14% (Pass: False). clinical_disclaimer: This adaptation experiment is a quantitative domain adaptation proof-of-concept on 81 IDRiD images. It DOES NOT constitute clinical validation, specialist validation, or evidence of patient outcomes.
